content_html:
The Sacred Valley of the Inca It is one of the most fascinating destinations in Peru. Located a few kilometers from Cusco, this valley combines Andean landscapes, traditional towns and archaeological sites that were key to the Inca civilization.

If you have little time in Cusco, dedicate a full day to the Sacred Valley is a wise decision.

Essential places in the Sacred Valley

Pisac

Famous for its archaeological complex and its artisan market.

  • Impressive Inca terraces
  • Traditional market (ideal for souvenirs)

Entrance price:
Included in the Cusco Tourist Ticket

Ollantaytambo

One of the best preserved Inca towns in Peru.

  • Inca fortress with huge platforms
  • Original streets from the Inca era
  • Starting point to Machu Picchu

Entrance price:
Included in the Cusco Tourist Ticket

Chinchero

Living tradition and Andean textiles.

  • archaeological center
  • Traditional textile workshops
  • colonial church

Entrance price:
Included in the Cusco Tourist Ticket

Prices and tickets

Cusco Tourist Ticket (partial – Sacred Valley):

  • Approximate: 70 – 80 soles
  • ⏰ Valid for 1 day
  • Includes: Pisac, Ollantaytambo and Chinchero

Prices may vary depending on the season.

How to organize your day from Cusco?

Option 1: Organized tour (recommended)

  • Round trip transportation
  • Professional guide
  • Strategic stops
  • Buffet lunch (optional)

⏱ Duration: 8–10 hours

Option 2: On your own

  • Public transport or taxi
  • Greater flexibility
  • Requires prior planning

⏱Variable duration

Helpful tips

Depart early from Cusco
Bring cash to artisan markets
Use sunscreen and a hat
Wear comfortable clothes and a light jacket

Is the Sacred Valley worth visiting?

Definitely yes. It is the perfect complement before visiting Machu Picchu and a unique opportunity to understand the greatness of the Inca Empire.
